shared_elements: raised relief figures set on a flat vertical panel
justification: The only correspondence is the generic one of profile-view figures carved in low relief on a flat upright panel; A shows a single large quadruped in profile with a smaller creature beneath it and no other content, while B shows a rayed disc above a group of human figures at an offering table over dense registers of small repeated sign-like marks. There is no shared motif, no shared relationship between elements, and the compositional logic (isolated animal vs. scene-plus-inscription hierarchy) is entirely different.
